pages.title: File:Center of BGC concentric circle roads.jpg

ObjectName.value: Center of BGC concentric circle roads

ImageDescription.value: Here we are looking south (197°), at the exact center of the circle inscribed by Rizal Drive, 590 meters away in all directions. We are at the virtual intersection of 8<sup>th</sup> Avenue and 29<sup>th</sup> Street (Bonifacio High Street.) This would be Kilometer Zero. No, there is no plaque here at all discussing this.

Artist.value: Jidanni
